description: Release UAT stage 3 (olap shard) intermittently fails singlestore x tpchavoc SF0.01 on query 10_v8 with error 1712: about 12.6 GB of query-execution memory against about 0.5 GB of table memory. The exists_to_derived_join rewrite (dialect_compat.py SINGLESTORE_EXISTS_JOIN_VARIANT_IDS) did not hold: on the same source (7eba31ea4e), release-v2 run 41709904857 passed in 199 s, and run 41738182507 failed all 4 executions. Failures were also seen in release UAT dry runs 2 and 5. Suspected causes: plan nondeterminism without table statistics (the adapter never runs ANALYZE after load), or drift in the unpinned singlestoredb-dev:latest image (docker/singlestore/docker-compose.yml:3).
